nodes.label: App Icon — white calendar with red X on black rounded square

Calendar app branding: minimalist flat calendar glyph (white outline, three top binding rings, 3x4 grid of day cells) on a near-black rounded-square ground; one cell marked by a small red square crossed out with a grey X — implies a scheduling/calendar app emphasizing a cancelled, blocked, or unavailable day. Same artwork used across all platforms/resolutions.
